images.title: A number made of nines and zeros
images.purpose: Shows 99009 as 9 × 10000 + 9 × 1000 + 9 × 1, each part a multiple of 9, so the number is a multiple of 9.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One number at the top splitting into three boxes in a row, with one brace below.
images.exact_structure: At the top, 99009 in large dark text, its three 9 digits drawn teal (#0072B2) and its two 0 digits grey (#6B7280). Three thin arrows lead down to a row of 3 rounded teal (#0072B2) outlined boxes: 9 × 10000, 9 × 1000 and 9 × 1. One green (#009E73) brace under all three boxes labelled all multiples of 9. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A number made only of nines and zeros is a multiple of 9, because each part is 9 times a place value.
